# 🚀 Getting Started ✨

### 🏁 Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/MidnightRaven9/MidnightLedger.git
cd MidnightLedger
npm install
npm run dev
```

### 📲 Install as PWA
1. Open: https://midnightledger.justicegraff6.workers.dev 💻
2. iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen 📱
3. Android: Menu → Install App 🤖

Installs as **MidnightLedger** 🌙 with purple icon 💜✨
